### Load packages and data

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(caret)
library(glmnet)
library(here)
library(ggplot2)
library(flextable)
library(glmnet)


# Load the merged TPM dataset
analysis_tmm <- readRDS(here("data", "processed", "analysis_tmm.rds"))

# Check dimensions
dim(analysis_tmm)

```

### Separate the outcome and predictors

```{r}
# Outcome: Day 7 plasmablast frequency
y_vec <- analysis_tmm$pf_d7

# Identify gene columns using their Ensembl IDs
gene_cols <- grep(
  "^ENSG",
  names(analysis_tmm),
  value = TRUE
)

# Extract gene expression matrix
X_mat <- as.matrix(analysis_tmm[, gene_cols])

# Transform TPM values
# X_mat <- log2(X_mat + 1)

# Primary outcome: natural-log-transformed plasmablast frequency
stopifnot(all(y_vec > 0))
y_log <- log(y_vec)

# Verify dimensions
dim(X_mat)
length(y_vec)
```

### Elastic net regression with nested cross-validation

```{r}

set.seed(123)
# Create five outer folds for model evaluation
folds <- createFolds(
  y_vec,
  k = 5,
  list = TRUE
)

# Check number of participants in each test fold
sapply(folds, length)
```

### Additional analyses

## Combined elastic net model with baseline gene expression + age + sex

```{r}

# =========================================================
# Combined elastic net: gene expression + demographics
# =========================================================

# Create numeric demographic predictors
# model.matrix() converts biological_sex into a dummy variable
demographic_mat <- model.matrix(
  ~ age + biological_sex,
  data = analysis_tmm,)[, -1, drop = FALSE]

# Combine gene expression with demographic predictors
X_combined <- cbind(
  X_mat,
  demographic_mat
)

# Check dimensions
dim(X_combined)

# Check demographic variable names
colnames(demographic_mat)

# Confirm rows match the outcome
# stopifnot(
#   nrow(X_combined) == length(y_vec),
#   !anyNA(X_combined),
#   all(is.finite(X_combined))
# )

```

## Log-transformed outcome: comparison of the 4 models

```{r}
# =========================================================
# Log-transformed outcome: comparison of four models
# =========================================================

# Outcome
stopifnot(all(y_vec > 0))
y_log <- log(y_vec)

# Missing vaccination histories must be NA, not zero
vax_count <- analysis_tmm$n_prior_vax
#vax_count[!vax_available] <- NA_real_

log_pf_d0 <- analysis_tmm$log_pf_d0

# Reuse existing gene-expression matrix
# X_mat already contains log2(TPM + 1)

# Gene expression + age + sex
X_log_demographic <- X_combined

# Expanded grid for log-transformed outcome
# log_elastic_net_grid <- expand.grid(
#   alpha = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
#   lambda = c(
#     0.000001, 0.00001, 0.0001,
#     0.001, 0.01, 0.05,
#     0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 1
#   )
# )

log_elastic_net_grid <- expand.grid(
  alpha  = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
  lambda = 10^seq(-3, 4, length.out = 30)   # 0.001 to 10,000
)

# Define model predictor sets
log_models <- list(
  "Gene expression" = X_mat,
  "Genes + age + sex" = X_log_demographic,
  "Genes + age + sex + vaccination history" = X_log_demographic
)

rmse_only <- function(data, lev = NULL, model = NULL) {
  c(RMSE = sqrt(mean((data$obs - data$pred)^2)))
}
```

```{r}
# Store held-out predictions on the LOG scale
log_model_predictions <- list()

# Store tuning parameters
log_model_tuning <- list()

# Baseline model: training-set mean of log outcome
log_baseline_predictions <- rep(NA_real_, length(y_log))

for (i in seq_along(folds)) {

  test_idx <- folds[[i]]

  log_baseline_predictions[test_idx] <- mean(y_log[-test_idx])
}

log_model_predictions[["Training-mean baseline"]] <-
  log_baseline_predictions

# Fit the three elastic net models
for (model_name in names(log_models)) {

  cat("\nRunning:", model_name, "\n")

  X_current <- log_models[[model_name]]

  predictions <- rep(NA_real_, length(y_log))

  tuning <- data.frame(
    Fold = seq_along(folds),
    Alpha = NA_real_,
    Lambda = NA_real_
  )

  for (i in seq_along(folds)) {

    cat("Outer fold", i, "\n")

    test_idx <- folds[[i]]

    X_train <- X_current[-test_idx, , drop = FALSE]
    X_test <- X_current[test_idx, , drop = FALSE]

    y_train <- y_log[-test_idx]

    # Add vaccination history only for the third model
    if (model_name == "Genes + age + sex + vaccination history") {

      median_impute <- function(X_train, X_test) {
          na_cols <- which(colSums(is.na(X_train)) > 0 | colSums(is.na(X_test)) > 0)
          for (j in na_cols) {
            med <- median(X_train[, j], na.rm = TRUE)
            X_train[is.na(X_train[, j]), j] <- med
            X_test[is.na(X_test[, j]), j]   <- med
          }
        list(train = X_train, test = X_test)
      }
      
      X_train <- cbind(X_train, n_prior_vax = vax_count[-test_idx])
      X_test  <- cbind(X_test,  n_prior_vax = vax_count[test_idx])
      
      imp     <- median_impute(X_train, X_test)
      X_train <- imp$train
      X_test  <- imp$test
    }

    covars <- c("age", "biological_sexMale")
        # Identify nonzero-variance predictors using outer training data
    # na.rm = TRUE allows the vaccination variable to contain NA
    # keep_predictors <- apply(
    #   X_train,
    #   2,
    #   function(x) {
    #     v <- var(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    #     is.finite(v) && v > 0
    #   }
    # )
    
    # X_train <- X_train[, keep_predictors, drop = FALSE]
    # X_test <- X_test[, keep_predictors, drop = FALSE]
    # 
    # Median imputation is required only for the vaccination model
    # if (model_name ==
    #     "Genes + age + sex + vaccination history") {
    # 
    #   preprocessing <- c("zv", "center", "scale")
    # 
    # } else {
    # 
    # preprocessing <- c("zv", "center", "scale")
    # }

    # Use the same inner CV splits for each model
    
    pf <- ifelse(colnames(X_train) %in% covars, 0, 1)
    
    
    set.seed(1000 + i)

    inner_folds <- createFolds(
      y_train,
      k = 5,
      returnTrain = TRUE
    )

    # Fit elastic net
    model <- caret::train(
      x = X_train,
      y = y_train,
      method = "glmnet",
      tuneGrid = log_elastic_net_grid,
      trControl = trainControl(
        method = "cv",
        index = inner_folds,
        summaryFunction = rmse_only
      ),
      metric = "RMSE",
      #preProcess = preprocessing,
      standardize = TRUE,
      penalty.factor = pf
    )

    # Held-out predictions on log scale
    predictions[test_idx] <- as.numeric(
      predict(model, newdata = X_test)
    )

    tuning$Alpha[i] <- model$bestTune$alpha
    tuning$Lambda[i] <- model$bestTune$lambda
  }

  log_model_predictions[[model_name]] <- predictions
  log_model_tuning[[model_name]] <- tuning
}

# Check that every model predicted all 29 participants
stopifnot(
  all(sapply(log_model_predictions, function(x) !anyNA(x)))
)
```

```{r}
# Calculate RMSE and R2 using log-transformed outcome
evaluate_log_model <- function(predicted) {

  c(
    RMSE = sqrt(mean((y_log - predicted)^2)),

    R2 = 1 -
      sum((y_log - predicted)^2) /
      sum((y_log - mean(y_log))^2)
  )
}

log_model_results <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(log_model_predictions, evaluate_log_model)
)

log_model_results <- data.frame(
  Model = names(log_model_predictions),
  log_model_results,
  row.names = NULL
)

log_model_results
```

```{r}
# Standardize RMSE using the SD of the log-transformed outcome
sd_log_outcome <- sd(y_log)

log_model_results$Standardized_RMSE <-
  log_model_results$RMSE / sd_log_outcome

log_model_results
```

## Leave-one-out cross validation analysis

```{r}
# =========================================================
# Sensitivity analysis: Nested LOOCV
# Log-transformed outcome, n = 29
# =========================================================

n <- length(y_log)

# Store predictions for all four models
loocv_predictions <- list(
  "Training-mean baseline" = rep(NA_real_, n),
  "Gene expression" = rep(NA_real_, n),
  "Genes + age + sex" = rep(NA_real_, n),
  "Genes + age + sex + vaccination history" = rep(NA_real_, n)
  #"Genes + age + sex + day 0 plasmablast frequency" = rep(NA_real_, n),
  #"Genes + age + sex + vaccination history + day 0 plasmablast frequency" = rep(NA_real_, n)
)

# Store elastic net tuning parameters
loocv_tuning <- list()

# Three elastic net predictor sets
loocv_models <- list(
  "Gene expression" = X_mat,
  "Genes + age + sex" = X_combined,
  "Genes + age + sex + vaccination history" = X_combined
  #"Genes + age + sex + day 0 plasmablast frequency" = X_combined,
  #"Genes + age + sex + vaccination history + day 0 plasmablast frequency" = X_combined
)

for (model_name in names(loocv_models)) {

  cat("\nRunning LOOCV:", model_name, "\n")

  X_current <- loocv_models[[model_name]]

  tuning <- data.frame(
    Participant = seq_len(n),
    Alpha = NA_real_,
    Lambda = NA_real_
  )

  for (i in seq_len(n)) {

    cat("Held-out participant", i, "of", n, "\n")

    # Hold out one participant
    test_idx <- i

    X_train <- X_current[-test_idx, , drop = FALSE]
    X_test <- X_current[test_idx, , drop = FALSE]
    
    y_train <- y_log[-test_idx]

    # Training-mean baseline
    loocv_predictions[["Training-mean baseline"]][test_idx] <-
      mean(y_train)
    
    covars <- c("age", "biological_sexMale")

    # Add vaccination history only for the third model
    if (model_name == "Genes + age + sex + vaccination history") {
      
      covars <- c("age", "biological_sexMale", "n_prior_vax")
      
      median_impute <- function(X_train, X_test) {
          na_cols <- which(colSums(is.na(X_train)) > 0 | colSums(is.na(X_test)) > 0)
          for (j in na_cols) {
            med <- median(X_train[, j], na.rm = TRUE)
            X_train[is.na(X_train[, j]), j] <- med
            X_test[is.na(X_test[, j]), j]   <- med
          }
        list(train = X_train, test = X_test)
      }
      
      imp     <- median_impute(X_train, X_test)
      X_train <- imp$train
      X_test  <- imp$test
    }
    
    
    
    pf <- ifelse(colnames(X_train) %in% covars, 0, 1)


    # Inner five-fold cross-validation
    set.seed(1000 + i)

    inner_folds <- createFolds(
      y_train,
      k = 5,
      returnTrain = TRUE
    )

    # Fit elastic net
    model <- caret::train(
      x = X_train,
      y = y_train,
      method = "glmnet",
      tuneGrid = log_elastic_net_grid,
      trControl = trainControl(
        method = "cv",
        index = inner_folds,
        summaryFunction = rmse_only
      ),
      metric = "RMSE",
      #preProcess = c("zv", "center", "scale"),
      standardize = TRUE,
      penalty.factor = pf
    )

    # Predict held-out participant on log scale
    loocv_predictions[[model_name]][test_idx] <-
      as.numeric(predict(model, newdata = X_test))

    tuning$Alpha[i] <- model$bestTune$alpha
    tuning$Lambda[i] <- model$bestTune$lambda
  }

  loocv_tuning[[model_name]] <- tuning
}

# Confirm all predictions are available
stopifnot(
  all(sapply(loocv_predictions, function(x) !anyNA(x)))
)

table(loocv_tuning[["Gene expression"]]$Lambda)
table(loocv_tuning[["Gene expression"]]$Alpha)
```

```{r}
# Evaluate on the LOG-TRANSFORMED outcome scale
evaluate_loocv <- function(predicted) {

  rmse <- sqrt(mean((y_log - predicted)^2))

  c(
    RMSE = rmse,
    R2 = 1 -
      sum((y_log - predicted)^2) /
      sum((y_log - mean(y_log))^2),
    Standardized_RMSE = rmse / sd(y_log)
  )
}

loocv_results <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(loocv_predictions, evaluate_loocv)
)

loocv_results <- data.frame(
  Model = names(loocv_predictions),
  loocv_results,
  row.names = NULL
)

loocv_results
```

```{r}
# Add standardized RMSE if not already present
log_model_results$Standardized_RMSE <-
  log_model_results$RMSE / sd(y_log)

# Stack results for comparison
cv_comparison <- rbind(
  data.frame(
    Validation = "5-fold nested CV",
    log_model_results
  ),
  data.frame(
    Validation = "Nested LOOCV",
    loocv_results
  )
)

cv_comparison
```

## Leave-one-out cross validation analysis with B_cell subset

```{r}
# =========================================================
# Sensitivity analysis: Nested LOOCV
# Log-transformed outcome, n = 29
# B cell gene subset
# =========================================================

n <- length(y_log)


bcells <- readRDS(here("data","Bcell_predictive_dataset.rds"))

genes_of_interest <- bcells$gene_sets$B_cell


keep <- intersect(genes_of_interest, colnames(X_mat))

length(genes_of_interest)
length(keep)

X_sub <- X_mat[, keep, drop = FALSE]

X_combined <- cbind(
  X_sub,
  demographic_mat
)

# Store predictions for all four models
loocv_predictions <- list(
  "Training-mean baseline" = rep(NA_real_, n),
  "Gene expression" = rep(NA_real_, n),
  "Genes + age + sex" = rep(NA_real_, n),
  "Genes + age + sex + vaccination history" = rep(NA_real_, n)
  #"Genes + age + sex + day 0 plasmablast frequency" = rep(NA_real_, n),
  #"Genes + age + sex + vaccination history + day 0 plasmablast frequency" = rep(NA_real_, n)
)

# Store elastic net tuning parameters
loocv_tuning <- list()

# Three elastic net predictor sets
loocv_models <- list(
  "Gene expression" = X_sub,
  "Genes + age + sex" = X_combined,
  "Genes + age + sex + vaccination history" = X_combined
  #"Genes + age + sex + day 0 plasmablast frequency" = X_combined,
  #"Genes + age + sex + vaccination history + day 0 plasmablast frequency" = X_combined
)

for (model_name in names(loocv_models)) {

  cat("\nRunning LOOCV:", model_name, "\n")

  X_current <- loocv_models[[model_name]]

  tuning <- data.frame(
    Participant = seq_len(n),
    Alpha = NA_real_,
    Lambda = NA_real_
  )

  for (i in seq_len(n)) {

    cat("Held-out participant", i, "of", n, "\n")

    # Hold out one participant
    test_idx <- i

    X_train <- X_current[-test_idx, , drop = FALSE]
    X_test <- X_current[test_idx, , drop = FALSE]
    
    y_train <- y_log[-test_idx]

    # Training-mean baseline
    loocv_predictions[["Training-mean baseline"]][test_idx] <-
      mean(y_train)
    
    covars <- c("age", "biological_sexMale")

    # Add vaccination history only for the third model
    if (model_name == "Genes + age + sex + vaccination history") {
      
      covars <- c("age", "biological_sexMale", "n_prior_vax")
      
      median_impute <- function(X_train, X_test) {
          na_cols <- which(colSums(is.na(X_train)) > 0 | colSums(is.na(X_test)) > 0)
          for (j in na_cols) {
            med <- median(X_train[, j], na.rm = TRUE)
            X_train[is.na(X_train[, j]), j] <- med
            X_test[is.na(X_test[, j]), j]   <- med
          }
        list(train = X_train, test = X_test)
      }
      
      imp     <- median_impute(X_train, X_test)
      X_train <- imp$train
      X_test  <- imp$test
    }
    
    pf <- ifelse(colnames(X_train) %in% covars, 0, 1)


    # Inner five-fold cross-validation
    set.seed(1000 + i)

    inner_folds <- createFolds(
      y_train,
      k = 5,
      returnTrain = TRUE
    )

    # Fit elastic net
    model <- caret::train(
      x = X_train,
      y = y_train,
      method = "glmnet",
      tuneGrid = log_elastic_net_grid,
      trControl = trainControl(
        method = "cv",
        index = inner_folds,
        summaryFunction = rmse_only
      ),
      metric = "RMSE",
      #preProcess = c("zv", "center", "scale"),
      standardize = TRUE,

    # Predict held-out participant on log scale
```
